scope: Independently authored Hindi and Arabic body paragraphs around one editable inline OMML fraction in its own paragraph. This is a working-tree observation, not live Word execution, complete #153 qualification or same-font geometry parity.
provenance: Synthetic python-docx 1.2.0 (MIT) paragraphs with independently authored OMML and normalized ZIP metadata. Both inputs were regenerated byte for byte. Open XML SDK 3.5.1 reported zero errors for both source and saved documents; validator DLL SHA-256 4126071233c70310683c0fa0b65648bbd34839afa7b0a2309fba13c22501ddec.

hindi.fontLimitation: The native renderer used the caller's STIX Two Math; LibreOffice selected DejaVu Serif even when the OMML runs explicitly requested STIX. This comparison does not establish same-font parity or attribute the entire difference to either engine.

controlsAndTools: The checkers verified retained numerator/denominator, paragraph/object order and actual fraction-rule paths. They rejected a changed denominator (DOCX SHA-256 31cd08feefbf71ca6214b37ca397a90741ee8486f941c5aa2809f2b3c33dc398) and a reference PDF missing the equation. LibreOffice 24.2.7.2 with matching Math component ran offline in image sha256:f8d9e1956969c7052974e0f7d05f814cb4c814b4c5db74592e8f2ed666fce5b6, built from sha256:a3aaef646226d406fc2b511462beb0359f4cd8859d775f404bd8f137dfd5f644 plus Ubuntu libreoffice-math 4:24.2.7-0ubuntu0.24.04.7. Poppler 25.03.0 and PyMuPDF 1.27.2.2 supplied text and geometry.
retainedEarlierAttempts: The first focused build failed analyzer checks CA2249 and CA1861; the tests were corrected. A later focused negative selected incompatible legacy typography options and produced ArgumentException before reaching the intended object boundary; its options were corrected. The original reference image lacked LibreOffice Math and silently omitted the fraction; its PDF SHA-256 83cd765465e654d6ad6f0107f28c92262e908eeb7b876b5a91df35c3dcdae734 is retained as a negative control. Installing the matching component restored the equation. The first Arabic prototype's PDF SHA-256 178bbeed7e68330a812274abc500ab039a7222290135cf397adde81bc1d1103d exposed the same directional extraction mismatch before the final diagnostic was added.
limitations: Generated documents and PDFs remain scratch artifacts. Exact-commit, package and hosted runtime evidence are separate. Notes, charts, mixed inline owners, equation cells and stories, tagged/archive output, screen readers, same-font reference parity and complete #153 acceptance remain open.
